sources.entry: Simpo - macOS menubar app to post status quickly.

summary.one_liner: Simpo is a macOS menubar app for quickly posting text and images to Fanfou, Twitter, and Weibo accounts.
summary.what_it_does: The app sits in the macOS menu bar and lets you compose and send a status to one or several social network accounts at once. It supports Fanfou, Twitter, and Weibo logins, and the README says it can send images and text. You can customize the font, background color, and style, and manage drafts through preferences. It can load your recent statuses and mentions, and you can delete or repost from that list. Keyboard shortcuts are listed for switching accounts, inserting emoticons, and sending. The README is written in Chinese and English.
use_cases: post a status to several social accounts at once
quick posting from the macOS menu bar
send text and images to Fanfou, Twitter, or Weibo
review and delete recent posts and mentions
notable: Posts to multiple accounts in one action, selected with the Command key
Customizable font, background color, and style for posts
Lists recent statuses and the 20 most recent mentions, with delete and repost
Keyboard shortcuts for account switching, emoticon insertion, and sending
caveats: The README says the Fanfou HTTPS API change may make the app unstable, and that fixing it needs a large rewrite with no set date.

The README says the app has not been updated in a long time, and its Weibo support is limited by API restrictions (no topic insertion, no recent-message view, and an added weibo.com link), so it is not recommended for Weibo.
On first launch macOS may show an 'unidentified developer' alert that requires a manual System Preferences override.
